From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Audit logging discovery - SOC 2, GDPR, API logs

Hi Sophie / Daniel,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Summary of what we discussed:
  - Admin activity logs (UI actions, role changes, permission edits) are captured and available via both UI and API.
  - API request/response logs (per-request metadata, timestamp, requestor id, model used) stored for 90 days by default; configurable retention available for Dedicated/Private.
  - Exportability: logs can be exported as NDJSON/CSV via the console or pulled through our Logs API.
  - Immutability: write-once export snapshots and S3 export with object locking supported in Private deployments; hosted customers get append-only internal store with tamper-evident checksums.

Items we need from Acme to progress the SOC 2 / questionnaire flow:
- Current SOC 2 status (in-scope controls / report date), and whether Acme will accept a SOC 2 Type II from a vendor in progress.
- Any GDPR/HIPAA-specific requirements for log retention, PII redaction, or cross-border considerations.
- The contact for procurement/security to receive the vendor security questionnaire (you mentioned security@acme.com).

Proposed next steps:
1) You send the vendor questionnaire (if you have it) - we can start filling immediately.
2) I'll loop in our infra/security engineer to answer technical immutability/export questions.
3) If helpful, schedule a follow-up technical deep-dive next week (I can do Tue/Wed morning PT).

Attachments: I can attach a short PDF overview of our audit logging capabilities if that helps - let me know.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Sophie / Daniel -

Thanks - we've started filling the questionnaire and attached a preliminary one-pager and an export sample. High-level answers to your asks below (we'll add these into the questionnaire PDF):

- Export formats: NDJSON and CSV supported. Our Logs API can stream exports programmatically; exports include per-event metadata (timestamp, log_type, user_id, request_id, model_id, region, raw_payload_ref).
- Checksums / integrity: Export snapshots include SHA-256 checksums for each exported object. For Private deployments we recommend enabling S3 Object Lock (WORM) on the destination bucket; for Hosted we provide signed, time-bound export objects plus cryptographic checksum metadata and an append-only internal store with tamper-evident checksums - we can provide the checksum algorithm and verification steps for your ingestion process.
- Retention: Default 90 days for hosted; configurable up to multi-year for Dedicated/Private with policy controls per-tenant. We can support GDPR-related deletion workflows for user-level data while preserving audit trail metadata as required for compliance.

Attachments: redwood-audit-logging-overview.pdf, audit-logs-export-sample.csv (small sample with field names and fake entries).

Next steps: 
- We'll complete the questionnaire and send the filled PDF by EOD Monday.
- Would you be available for a technical deep-dive on Mon 24 May at 10:00 PT? If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
